name: Prep me for a meeting
tagline: Run this before any external meeting. I'll search Gmail for prior threads and drop a 200-word brief in Slack.
description: I look up everyone in the meeting in your Gmail history, summarize what was discussed before, what's still open, and suggest talking points. Designed for AEs who want to walk in cold-but-warm.

test_cases.name: known customer with history
test_cases.rubric: Agent searches Gmail for sara@acme.com, summarizes 3+ prior threads with dates, identifies open questions, posts to Slack.

test_cases.name: new contact, no history
test_cases.rubric: Agent finds no Gmail history, says so explicitly in the brief, suggests opening questions. Does NOT fabricate context.

test_cases.name: multiple attendees, one with churn signal
test_cases.rubric: Agent searches for both, flags any tone shift or pricing complaint in past threads in the 'Anything weird' section.
